Lomanto Junior says:
        - Commander Inácio Silvestre dos Santos, of the BADIA company, who was operating the aircraft with the prefix PP-SDI, on a Rio-S. Paulo air bridge flight on December 18, 1965 at 20:30, spotted above Gunnarah a luminous, spherical object emitting clear blue light.
